title: On the no-contention (single-attempt) path each pen writer now does two `git sh…
body: On the no-contention (single-attempt) path each pen writer now does two `git show main:` reads (the up-front dedup/not-found guard read plus the per-attempt callback read of identical content). Correct and negligible, but the first attempt's callback could reuse the already-read content to save one subprocess on the happy path.
